newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS CLOSE DOWN IN CONTINUING BEAR-RUN.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS CLOSE DOWN IN CONTINUING BEAR-RUN.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended down sharply as small investors mounted a selling pressure to minimise losses in a falling market, brokers said on Wednesday.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index dropped 21.53 points or 2.27 percent to 925.02 on turnover of 48.1 million taka. Losers led gainers by 117 to 17.
Brokers said small investors needed fund while institutional investors kept to the sideline.
"The bear-run will continue if there is no move for arming investors with cash. The market is severely suffering from cash crunch," said broker Khurshid Alam.
Commercial banks have stopped offering loans against shares as they face liquidity crisis.
Alam said the sentiment of the retail investors was depressed due to absence of institutional buyers.
Bangladesh Lamps declined 287 taka to 4,380, Shine Pukur lost 1.54 to 115.38 and Bata Shoe Company shed 3.4 to 113.57.
